name: Melvin Bernard
original_name: メルヴィン・ベルナード
source:
Cleric Melvin Bernard is the former pupil and current partner of [url=/c63]Cleric Bartholomew Tirelli[/url].

While clerics normally work solo, Tirelli and Bernard have an unseen duo combat method and their monthly case clearance rate is one of the highest among their peers. He recently attained the rank of Master in Gun Kata.
